page.layout: One printed page of text in two kinds of type: Hebrew and Chaldee headwords with Latin glosses and citations, set in lines with indents. No margin notes. Running head at top, page number 57 at top left. A single letter H at the foot of the text.

main_text.p:
בכא בָּכָה Chal.& Syr. Flere, Plorare, Lachrymari.
Pahel Particip. מְבַכִּין Deflebant, Ezech.8.14.
בְּבִיתָא בְּכִיָא בְּכִי כְּבָּן Chal.& Syr. Fletus, Ploratus, Lamentatio.
בְּוּכְרָא בָּכַר Ch. & Syr. Primogenitus, Primogenitum, Plur. בּוּכְרִין בּוּכְרָיָא Primogenita, Pf.135.8.
בְּכְרוּתָא Ch. Primogenitura, Jus primogenituræ, Genef.25.31.32.
בַּכֵּר Pahel Ch. Primogenitum efficere vel instituere, Jus primogenituræ dare, Deut.21.16. Ithpah. Futur. דִּיתְבַּכַּר Quod primum gignetur, Levit.27.26.
בְּכוֹרָא Ch. Præcox, primus, primitivus fructus, Primitiæ. Plur. בְּכוֹרַיָא.
בְּכִיר Ch. Idem. Item Prima, Tempestiva pluvia; Plur. כְּתִינִין בְּכִירִין sicut ficus præcoces, Jerem.24.2. Sic Syr.
בֵּל Ch. Cor, Animus, quasi transpositis literis לֵב, juxta plerosque, Dan.6.14.
בְּלָא Ch.& Syr. Veterascere, Inveterascere, Vetustate atteri. Ithpeh, Ch. אִתְבְּלִי Idem. Pahel בַּלִּי Deterere, Atterere.

page.notes: Hebrew and Chaldee forms are set in a small, cramped type with vowel points; several word forms, especially the vowel points and the pointed forms in the middle lines, are uncertain and may differ in detail. The Hebrew in the lines 4, 10, 13 and 15 is only approximately reproduced. Page is otherwise clear.
